prompts.prompt: List all open issues labeled 'bug' in the repo acme/widgets, read the details of the most recent one, and add a comment saying 'Triaging — will investigate this week'
assertions: Uses list_issues tool with owner='acme', repo='widgets', state='open', labels='bug'
Uses issue_read tool with the issue number from the list results
Uses add_issue_comment tool with the correct issue_number and comment body
Does not fall back to shell commands like curl or gh CLI for any of the three operations

with_skill.plan: 1. Call list_issues(owner='acme', repo='widgets', state='open', labels='bug') to get filtered issues. 2. Identify the most recent issue by created_at date from the returned list. 3. Call issue_read(owner='acme', repo='widgets', issue_number=<number>) to get full details. 4. Call add_issue_comment(owner='acme', repo='widgets', issue_number=<number>, body='Triaging — will investigate this week').

baseline.plan: No GitHub MCP tools available. Would use 'gh issue list --repo acme/widgets --state open --label bug' via bash, then 'gh issue view <number>' for details, then 'gh issue comment <number> --body ...' to add comment. All three operations use the gh CLI, not dedicated skill tools.
